🎁

💰

📅

👉

Venue: Gate
Headline: CFD Comeback Rewards: Share 24,000 USDT in Tokens and Earn Up to 962 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Exclusively for returning CFD traders. Register and reach the cumulative trading volume requirement to receive 2 USDT. Keep trading to unlock tiered airdrop rewards totaling up to 960 USDT. Earn up to 962 USDT in spot tokens per user, credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 26, 2026, 09:00 – December 10, 2026, 09:00 (UTC)
## Eligible Participants
This event is open only to users who have traded CFDs before and made no CFD trades during the 7 consecutive 24-hour periods immediately before the event starts.
## Event 1: Return to CFD Trading and Receive 2 USDT
During the event, eligible users who register and reach at least 120,000 USDx in cumulative CFD trading volume after registration can receive 2 USDT in spot tokens. Rewards are limited to the first 2,000 qualifying users and credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
## Event 2: Trade to Unlock an Airdrop of Up to 960 USDT
During the event, reach the required cumulative CFD trading volume after registration to unlock the USDT spot token reward for each tier. Each tier has its own task and reward pool. Rewards from different tiers can be combined for a total of up to 960 USDT. The total reward pool is 20,000 USDT. Rewards are credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
Trading Volume | Reward per User (USDT Spot Tokens) | Available Spots
5,000,000 USDx | 10 USDT | 850 users
30,000,000 USDx | 150 USDT | 50 users
100,000,000 USDx | 800 USDT | 5 users
## Important Notes
Participants must complete identity verification before selecting [Join Now] on the event page to register. Due to local policies and service coverage limits, participation and registration are temporarily unavailable in some regions.
Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume. Only activity after you register counts toward this event.
A "returning CFD trader" is a user who has traded CFDs before and made no CFD trades during the 7 consecutive 24-hour periods immediately before the event starts.
Event rewards are paid in USDT spot tokens and automatically credited to your account after you complete the corresponding tasks. If a reward is not credited, the rewards have either run out or you do not meet the task requirements.
Gate TradFi services may be restricted in certain jurisdictions, and users in some regions may be temporarily unable to use this feature. Trading traditional financial instruments involves market volatility, leverage risk, and liquidity risk. Before enabling TradFi trading, carefully read the Contract for Difference (CFD) Service Agreement, Risk Disclosure Statement, and terms for each asset class.
Users participating in other Gate events of the same type at the same time can receive rewards from only one event.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the event. Prohibited conduct includes using multiple accounts to participate repeatedly, impersonating others or submitting false identity verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling onchain funds, coordinating to improperly obtain rewards, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the event. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
Market makers, companies, and institutions are not eligible to participate in this event.
If there is any discrepancy between a translated version and the English version, the English version prevails.
Gate reserves the right to make the final interpretation of this event.
Some or all services (including participation in this event, games, or contests) are unavailable to users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions. For details about restricted regions, please read the User Agreement.

Venue: Gate
Headline: MEME Trading Challenge Round 2: Unlock Up to 100 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Gate Web3 is launching Round 2 of the MEME Trading Challenge, featuring tiered rewards for eligible traders. During the campaign, users who complete MEME coin trades and meet different trading volume targets can unlock USDT airdrop rewards tier by tier. The more you trade, the more rewards you earn, with up to 100 USDT in total.
Join Now
## Campaign Period: November 26, 2026, 09:00 — December 10, 2026, 09:00 (UTC)
## How to Participate
- Go to the Web3 page: Open the Gate App and tap [Web3] to enter the [Campaigns] page.
- Find this campaign and tap Sign Up.
- Use the Gate Web3 Wallet to trade MEME coins on-chain.
## Reward Rules
During the campaign, users can unlock corresponding rewards by reaching the specified cumulative MEME trading volume thresholds on Gate Web3, with a maximum reward of 100 USDT per user.
Task | Reward | Quota
Cumulative MEME trading volume ≥ 300 USDT | 3 USDT | First 200 users
Cumulative MEME trading volume ≥ 1,000 USDT | 5 USDT | First 100 users
Cumulative MEME trading volume ≥ 2,000 USDT | 10 USDT | First 100 users
Cumulative MEME trading volume ≥ 5,000 USDT | 20 USDT | First 50 users
Cumulative MEME trading volume ≥ 10,000 USDT | 50 USDT | First 50 users
Cumulative MEME trading volume ≥ 20,000 USDT | 100 USDT | First 20 users
## Campaign Rules
- Sign-up requirement: Only trading volume generated after signing up will be counted. Trades are not limited to specific blockchains or MEME tokens. Eligible on-chain MEME trades are counted toward the task. Trading volume generated from Futures Trading, Spot Trading, and Swap transactions will not be counted toward the campaign trading volume.
- Trading volume generated from zero-fee trading pairs will not be included in the campaign trading volume calculation.
- Rewards for each tier are limited and will be distributed on a first-come, first-served basis according to the order in which eligible users complete the tasks, while supplies last.
- Rewards will be distributed in USDT (BNB Chain); all rewards will be sent to winners' Wallet Addresses within 14 business days after the campaign ends.
- In the event of any discrepancy between translated versions and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
- Gate will review participants' accounts, trading activities, and fund transfers during the campaign period. Prohibited activities include, but are not limited to, participating through multiple accounts, identity impersonation or submission of false verification information, wash trading or self-trading, circular transfers of on-chain funds, coordinated attempts to exploit campaign rewards, repeated fund transfers, and any other activities that compromise the fairness of the campaign. Gate reserves the right to disqualify users from receiving rewards if any such violations are confirmed.
## Notes
- Digital asset trading involves high volatility. This campaign does not constitute investment advice.
- Participants are responsible for all taxes and Gas costs related to claiming rewards.
- Due to legal and regulatory restrictions, users in certain jurisdictions may not be eligible to participate in this campaign.
- The final campaign results will be based on the system settlement data after the campaign ends.
- Users participating in multiple campaigns during the same period can only receive one airdrop, based on the highest eligible airdrop amount.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation for this campaign. The platform reserves the right to adjust, suspend, or terminate the campaign rules to the extent permitted by law. The platform reserves the right of final interpretation of the terms of this campaign.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Comeback Sprint Season 9, 20,000 USDT Subsidy to Fuel Your Recovery

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
To thank you for your continued support and trust in Gate Bots, we are launching a Double Rewards Event, giving you more surprises with every trade.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 26, 2026, 08:00 - December 15, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Event 1: Lucky Draw—Rewards for Everyone
During the campaign,200 users who activate Bot trading will be randomly selected to receive a 10 USDT Bot Trial Voucher each.
## Event 2: Trade to Earn up to 2,000 USDT, +10% Extra for Returning Users
During the event, earn Bot Trial Funds based on your investment amount. Returning users can unlock bonus rewards based on their investment after completing their first bot trade.
Individual Cumulative Bot Investment (USDT) | Base Trial Funds (USDT) | Extra Bonus for Returning Users
200-5,000 | 20 | +5%
5,000-10,000 | 50 | +6%
10,000-50,000 | 150 | +7%
50,000-200,000 | 250 | +8%
200,000-500,000 | 1,000 | +9%
≥ 500,000 | 2,000 | +10%
## Notes
- During the event, trade using Gate Bots and complete the specified tasks to earn Trial Fund rewards.
- Returning Users: Users who have not traded with Gate Bots for at least 2 days before the event starts.
- All bot types are eligible.
- Rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the event ends.
- Rewards will be credited to users' Trial Fund accounts as Bot Trial Funds.
- Eligible bots must run for at least 24 hours.
- The total prize pool is 20,000 USDT, available on a first-come, first-served basis.
- Only users from eligible regions may participate (e.g., users from the UK are excluded).
- Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this event.
